en: The postcard features a black-and-white panoramic photograph of a port city seen from an elevated vantage point, with trees in the foreground. Distinct town buildings, a harbor, and hilly terrain are visible. At the bottom of the image, there is Swedish handwritten text. The reverse side has a Swedish 5 öre stamp, the word 'BREFKORT' and address fields filled out in Swedish cursive script.
